terminology: frequency-response-inspired spectral augmentation; capture-chain style, not measured causal RX hardware

v0.samples: all G1 selected raw float64 IQ rows, 200/TX/RX, 20000 packets; raw SHA rechecked
v0.fold_fit: each fold: fit only five training RX; the other five are source-held-out audits only
v0.basis: cos/sin of harmonics 1,2,3 of normalized frequency; six nonconstant periodic bases
v0.response: orthogonal projection of donor-source profile difference onto six bases; remove global mean; shrink whole curve only if max(abs(dB))>3; exp(log_response)
v0.variant_rule: each of four other RX in its fitting fold, strength exactly 1; no per-packet cherry-picking
v0.sigma: scalar population SD of unperturbed Full CIS across only five fitting RX, recomputed from raw; log10(power ratio) units
v0.cis: historical unchanged boxcar128/hop64, crop .3, 52x126, RMS normalization, epsilon1e-12 complex STFT; complex128
v0.delta: RMS((C(Tx)-C(x))/(sigma+1e-12)); packet_delta=median across four registered donor variants
negative_controls: constant full-band +3 dB gain through identical path
v0.artifact_mask: union of clean denominator bottom1% within packet, abs(clean_CIS)>10 (100dB), first/last2 ratio frames; no changing epsilon
v0.coherence: lag1024, diagnostic inherited conditional LoRa period; never proof of preamble or compensate CFO
v0.profile_stability: first/last100 rows per TX by original row order; 80% ordered pairs cosine>=.8 and half norm ratio in [.5,2]; no resampling
v0.tx_dominance: leave each TX out of class-balanced profiles; projected style relative L2 change across pair/TX, q95<=.25
v0.smoothness: six-basis projection energy divided by demeaned raw profile-difference energy, median>=.5
v0.heldout_spectrum: responses frozen before accessing other five source RX profiles; for each heldout RX best fitted-source+its registered response versus best clean fitted-source, >=10% L2 improvement for >=2/5 RX
v0.natural_cis: same-TX mean CIS centroid distances / fitting sigma: all cross-source-RX pairs versus same-RX synthetic mean displacement; ratio of medians [.1,10]; unpaired packets, not exact matched-signal ground truth
v0.early_stop: complete registered V0 audits and document failed gates; no V1/V2/V3 if any hard gate fails

v1.architecture: historical FactorizedAuthorCNN(rank16), shared for all methods
v1.tuning: zero hyperparameter sweeps for ALL methods; fixed scientifically defined recipes; no unequal search opportunity
v1.sample_budget: 10000 unique fitting packets/fold, each once/epoch; 50 base packets/batch, 5 views/base for all methods
v1.sampler: one sample per TX x RX cell/batch; independent seeded permutations without replacement per epoch
v1.B0: five copies clean per base sample, ordinary CE (equal computation/exposure budget)
v1.B1: clean + four independently AWGN augmented IQ views, SNR uniform[10,40]dB, complex circular noise; before unchanged CIS; .5*(CE_clean+mean CE_aug)
v1.B2: clean + four donor-specific frozen spectral augmentations, .5*(CE_clean + mean CE_aug)
v1.B3: same views as B2; .5*(CE_clean + mean CE_aug) + .25 * (logsumexp(5*group risks)-ln(40))/5
v1.B3_groups: TX x donor-index v, 40 groups, each represented by five RX samples in each balanced batch
v1.B4: no new augmentation; standard multiplicative-weight Group DRO, groups TX x source_RX=50, eta .01, weights normalized each batch; shared regularization
v1.selection: best mean per-RX held-out Macro-F1 checkpoint, tie earliest epoch; strongest baseline=max mean F1 of B0/B1/B4, tie B0,B1,B4
v1.metrics: per-RX Macro-F1, Worst-RX, per-RX worst-TX, pooled worst-TX, TX/RX recall differences and severe-degradation fraction

v2.source_confirmation: repeat same five-method two-fold protocol at other two seeds; retain initial seed; no recipe change
v2.go_rule: same V1 gates on means across seeds; B3 gain over fixed strongest seed1 baseline positive for all seeds; no severe TX/RX loss at any seed
v2.development_epochs: freeze ceil(mean source-CV best epochs across folds and seeds), separately for every method; no dev selection

v3.source_fit: all ten source RX only, 200 packets/TX/RX, same method budgets; three seeds; development evaluation after frozen fit
v3.single_source_definition: same six bases and ±3dB bound; fixed coefficients independent N(0,.05^2) natural-log amplitude, shrink only; RNG seed+epoch+sample identity; four v per sample
v3.OSU_direction_separation: freeze direction A source-only; target readonly audit B cannot tune anything; fixed model evaluation C only if included
v3.OSU_metadata: cf32 little endian, sample rate string 1 MS/s, 25 files, finite nonzero signals, byte counts divisible by8
v3.OSU_windows: historical aligned-to-file 8192 sample blocks, lag1024 coherence>=.8, at least20/class, deterministic linspace max200/class; no strict-preamble claim
v3.OSU_bad_target: stop direction, preserve failures; any new frontend protocol separately registered
v3.OSU_single_source_V0: same numerical/representation/IQ gates on direction source only before training; no inter-RX style gate in single-source setting

forbidden: read four Shen dev RX signals before V3
read six historical locked RX signals in v1
change ±3dB, bases, CFO, STFT, risk weights, thresholds after results
stop_policy: Any V0 or V1 hard failure stops this candidate. New hypotheses require independent registration and disclosure of this negative result.
literature_gate: source mechanism novelty not established; no submission novelty claim without primary fulltext comparison and fair strong baselines
